title: W14/VC-5: Incremental ancestor aggregates over observed grouping/ownership edges in ObservationProjection (measured counts, interval envelope, incomplete-trace label; inspector wiring excluded)
description:
Gap: ObservationProjection (src/workbench/observation.ts) keeps flat per-node indexes (status, kind, basis, evidence, version, time) but no ancestor aggregate: nothing answers "how many observed children/descendants does this group or Run have, in which status tones, with which interval envelope" without re-walking relations per frame. docs/workbench/10 requires ancestor aggregates to be maintained incrementally and the overview to show "status and counts"; docs/workbench/09 § Aggregates and profiling requires measured counts with an explicit "incomplete trace" label instead of a precise critical path. wb-9x5.2 (W21-A, seat g1) explicitly deferred "adding ancestor/supernode aggregation to observation.ts or workflow-inspector.ts" to a follow-up; wb-6ze.1 (W15 nested tree) is confined to the inspector and uses no new projection API. This bead supplies the read-model half only.

Scope (atomic, additive, hot-file free), all inside src/workbench/observation.ts:
- export interface AncestorAggregate { key: string; revision: number; topologyRevision: number; direct: { children: number; settled: number; byTone: Record<Presentation["statusTone"], number> }; descendants: { counted: number; byTone: Record<Presentation["statusTone"], number>; stale: number; depthReached: number; truncated: boolean }; intervals: { known: number; missing: number; open: number; earliestStartedAt?: string; latestEndedAt?: string }; trace: "incomplete" | "bounded"; criticalPath: "unestablished"; basis: "observed-grouping-ownership" }
- aggregate(filter: { scope: ObservationScope; key: string }): AncestorAggregate | undefined — a copied value; undefined for unknown or cross-scope keys without any traversal.
- aggregateStats(): { adjustments: number; rebuilds: number; maxVisitedPerUpdate: number } (additive; the existing stats() shape {nodes, events, edges} is unchanged).
Child edges are outgoing relations of kind 'grouping' or 'ownership' (parent = from, child = to). Set semantics: a descendant is counted once per ancestor even through diamonds. Depth cap AGGREGATE_DEPTH = 8 (same cap as wb-6ze.1); cycles terminate at the first repeated key. 'dependency', 'causation' and 'hypothesis' edges never trigger or contribute. Hot path: a node's status/interval/freshness change (ingest, refresh, markStale, disconnect, reconnect) adjusts its ancestors by walking incoming grouping/ownership edges with a per-walk visited set — O(depth x fan-in), never a scan of nodes or events. Topology changes (relate/removeEdge of grouping/ownership edges, discard/eviction) rebuild only the affected ancestors from their bounded subtree. settled = success + failure tones; stale = descendants whose freshness !== 'current'; intervals use source intervals only (earliest startedAt, latest endedAt; an open interval increments open and never fabricates an end); trace is 'incomplete' whenever intervals.missing > 0 or descendants.truncated; criticalPath is the literal 'unestablished' (no number, no estimate, no token or cost fields).

Out of scope: rendering counts in src/ui/workflow-inspector.ts (reserved this round by wb-6ze.1 and wb-g1g.1; a later bead wires overview counts), workflow_observe tool output (src/index.ts, hot), supernode collapse, concurrency/critical-path profiling, any cap change.

Quote docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md § "Aggregates and profiling": "Distinguish measured actual from estimated projected metrics. If dependencies or interval bounds are missing, suppress precise critical path claims and show \"incomplete trace\". Derive latency decomposition only with valid source intervals." Quote docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Four views" Overview: "Critical path must be shown as *partial/estimated* when relationships/times incomplete."

A7 Freshness rollup. disconnect('furnace') raises descendants.stale to the number of non-current descendants; reconnect alone leaves it unchanged; a refresh() snapshot lowers it. A8 Bounded work at scale. A 2,000-node, 5-level grouped tree receiving 100,000 status ingests: aggregateStats().maxVisitedPerUpdate <= 8 and aggregateStats().rebuilds does not grow with status updates (rebuilds count only topology changes); the median per-ingest time at 200 nodes vs 2,000 nodes is printed in the test output (reported, not asserted beyond the visit bound). Quote docs/workbench/02-atomic-requirements.md WB-045: "Hierarchical agent-swarm aggregation and profile comparisons handle 10k+ nodes subject to benchmarked limits."

A9 Scope isolation. aggregate() with a key from another workspace/principal returns undefined and leaves aggregateStats() unchanged. Quote docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md § "Data retention and privacy": "Tenant/workspace boundaries apply at correlation queries, not just at individual SDK calls."

Scope (atomic, pure, hot-file free): ONE new source file src/workbench/executable-identity.ts and ONE new test file test/workbench-executable-identity.test.ts; wire nothing.
- export const EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT = 'workbench.executable-identity/v1'
- export type ExecutableIdentityReason = 'sdk-default-executable' | 'not-found' | 'not-a-file' | 'not-executable' | 'symlink-depth' | 'too-large' | 'unreadable' | 'path-resolved' | 'shadowed-candidates' | 'search-truncated' (frozen set; nothing else is ever emitted).
- export interface ExecutableObservation { contractVersion: typeof EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT; requested: string | undefined; resolution: 'absolute' | 'path-search' | 'unresolved'; resolvedPath?: string; realPath?: string; symlinkHops: number; digest?: string (sha256:<hex>); sizeBytes?: number; mode?: number; candidates: number; immutability: 'digest-observed' | 'mutable-path' | 'unsupported'; reasons: readonly ExecutableIdentityReason[]; observedAt: string }
- export function observeExecutableIdentity(input: { command: string | undefined; cwd: string; path: string | undefined; observedAt: string; maxBytes?: number; maxSearchEntries?: number; maxSymlinkHops?: number }): ExecutableObservation — synchronous; reads only through node:fs (lstat, readlink, stat, chunked reads for hashing — never readFileSync of a whole binary); never imports node:child_process; never reads process.env (PATH is an explicit input); never throws for a missing, unreadable, non-regular, non-executable or oversized target — those are 'unresolved'/'unsupported' with a reason.
  • command undefined or empty -> resolution 'unresolved', immutability 'unsupported', reasons ['sdk-default-executable'] (the honest answer for the Claude built-in executable and any SDK default).
  • command containing a path separator -> resolved against cwd; symlinks followed hop by hop (count hops; above maxSymlinkHops, default 16, -> 'unsupported' with 'symlink-depth'); must be a regular file with an execute bit; hashed with sha256 when sizeBytes <= maxBytes (default 512 MiB) -> resolution 'absolute', immutability 'digest-observed'; oversize -> digest omitted, immutability 'unsupported', reasons ['too-large'].
  • bare command -> PATH searched in order (split on path.delimiter; at most maxSearchEntries, default 64, further entries ignored and 'search-truncated' recorded; relative or empty entries resolved against cwd); the first regular executable file wins; candidates counts every searched entry holding a same-named executable; resolution 'path-search'; the digest IS observed but immutability is 'mutable-path' with reasons ['path-resolved'] plus 'shadowed-candidates' when candidates > 1. A digest never upgrades a PATH-resolved binary to 'digest-observed'.
  • Result and its reasons are frozen; resolvedPath and realPath pass through redactWorkbenchText (paths may embed tokens); absent fields mean not observed, never a default.
- export function compareExecutableIdentity(recorded: ExecutableObservation, current: ExecutableObservation): { verdict: 'same' | 'changed' | 'unknown'; differences: readonly string[] } — 'same' only when both digests are present and equal AND both immutability values are 'digest-observed'; 'changed' when both digests are present and differ; otherwise 'unknown' (a mutable-path or unsupported side can never yield 'same'); differences names each differing field (digest, realPath, sizeBytes, mode, immutability, resolution).
